authority: attributes the P40000/O16 decode-step cost on the real API path; diagnostic only, no speedup, no route selection, no target change

per_step_decomposition_ms.note: gap is 0.28% of wall; launch overhead is NOT a material factor at P40000 (the graph-cache benefit at short positions is elsewhere)

all_gemv_mlp_projections.note: weight-read-bound; already micro-optimized to ceilings per ~54 decode metadata records

hardware_denominators_measured.note: D2D memcpy 95.4 GB/s is the authoritative sustained read+write figure; a read-only GEMV can approach or exceed it. The naive strided-read microkernel (38.9) is a low-MLP under-estimate, not the GEMV ceiling.

attention_analysis.kv_bytes_derivation: 16 full-attn layers x 40000 positions x 4 KV heads x 256 dim x 2 bytes x (K+V)

values_kernel.occupancy_note: 6144 threads / 16 SMs = 384/SM = 12 warps/SM; low occupancy for a bandwidth-bound kernel
values_kernel.gqa_redundancy: kExactAttentionValuePositionStride = KvHeads(4)*HeadDim(256) = 1024; the 6 query heads per KV head each re-read the identical V row => 6x redundant global V traffic

scores_kernel.note: well-parallelized (120k warps); 38.6 ms for 1.006 GB K reads => ~26 GB/s; less redundant than values but still below the 95 GB/s D2D ceiling

conclusion.gap_driver: The 2.5x P40000-vs-short decode gap (254 vs ~105 ms/token) is dominated by the two exact full-attention kernels (58.6% of the step), NOT by launch overhead (0.28%) and NOT by the fixed GEMV floor (already at its measured ceilings).
conclusion.values_kernel_is_the_primary_lever: attention_values_exact runs at ~2.6 GB/s effective (2.7% of the 95 GB/s D2D ceiling) with only 6144 threads and 6x GQA-redundant V reads. This is a kernel-efficiency defect, not a bandwidth wall.
conclusion.roofline: Even reading the full 2.0 GB KV once at the 95 GB/s D2D ceiling is ~21 ms/token for attention; the GEMV weight floor (~13.5 GB at ~95 GB/s) is ~140 ms/token. So the hard P40000 floor is ~160 ms/token (~6.2 tok/s), below the 10 tok/s target. Reaching 10 tok/s at P40000 requires reducing KV bytes (FP8/quantized KV or a bandwidth-optimal attention dataflow) AND pushing the GEMV floor toward the measured read ceiling.
conclusion.short_context: At short context the attention term is negligible and the ~105 ms/token is the GEMV floor; 9.51 tok/s is already ~95% of target and the remaining gap is GEMV read efficiency toward the 95 GB/s ceiling.

rejected_or_bounded: launch-overhead / graph-cache extension to long positions: gap is 0.28%, not the lever
fixed GEMV micro-optimization: ~54 prior records show these are at ceilings; not the P40000 lever

this record claims no speedup and selects no route; it names the architecture-level direction (bandwidth-optimal, GQA-redundancy-free exact attention for the S>=65 path) as the candidate to evaluate against the real P40000/O16 API
